description: Source code for the BaseDrawing class in PhpSpreadsheet library, managing image drawing properties within a worksheet, including positioning, size, rotation, and hyperlink.

methods.name: getImageIndex
methods.description: Returns the unique index of the image object.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name property of the drawing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name property of the drawing.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description property of the drawing.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description property of the drawing.

methods.name: setWorksheet
methods.description: Associates the drawing with a worksheet, optionally overriding existing association.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the worksheet object associated with the drawing.

methods.name: setCoordinates
methods.description: Sets the cell coordinate where the drawing is anchored.

methods.name: getCoordinates
methods.description: Returns the cell coordinate where the drawing is anchored.

methods.name: setOffsetX
methods.description: Sets the X offset for the drawing position.

methods.name: getOffsetX
methods.description: Returns the X offset for the drawing.

methods.name: setOffsetY
methods.description: Sets the Y offset for the drawing position.

methods.name: getOffsetY
methods.description: Returns the Y offset for the drawing.

methods.name: setCoordinates2
methods.description: Sets the second set of coordinates for two-cell anchoring.

methods.name: getCoordinates2
methods.description: Returns the second set of coordinates for anchoring.

methods.name: setOffsetX2
methods.description: Sets the second X offset.

methods.name: getOffsetX2
methods.description: Returns the second X offset.

methods.name: setOffsetY2
methods.description: Sets the second Y offset.

methods.name: getOffsetY2
methods.description: Returns the second Y offset.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the drawing, resizing proportionally if enabled.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the drawing.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the drawing, resizing proportionally if enabled.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the drawing.

methods.name: setResizeProportional
methods.description: Enables or disables proportional resizing.

methods.name: getResizeProportional
methods.description: Returns whether proportional resizing is enabled.

methods.name: setRotation
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle of the drawing.

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Returns the rotation angle.

methods.name: setShadow
methods.description: Sets the shadow properties for the drawing.

methods.name: getShadow
methods.description: Returns the shadow object.

methods.name: setHyperlink
methods.description: Associates a hyperlink with the image.

methods.name: getHyperlink
methods.description: Returns the hyperlink object associated with the image.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the image type.

methods.name: getImageWidth
methods.description: Returns the original image width.

methods.name: getImageHeight
methods.description: Returns the original image height.

methods.name: setEditAs
methods.description: Sets the 'edit as' mode, must be one of predefined valid modes.

methods.name: getEditAs
methods.description: Returns the current 'edit as' mode.

methods.name: validEditAs
methods.description: Checks if the current 'edit as' mode is valid.
